concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-017 (source a publicly available real‑world scale‑free network with geographic coordinates) is not referenced in any phase of the implementation plan; the plan’s FR mapping table omits FR‑017.
Phase 7 is listed without any associated FR or SC. Contract validation is already covered by FR‑016 in Phase 6, so this entry appears redundant and constitutes an over‑reach beyond the specification.
